decisions.forum_structure: Single recurring consolidated forum replacing the two separate weekly forums, with a protected confidential segment built into each session

commitments.detail: A written confidentiality protocol will govern the 30-minute protected confidential segment handling escalation cases that cannot be discussed in the open portion of the forum.
Live video access will be provided so remote employees can participate in real time at the 11:00 start time.
A recorded summary will be made available whenever an individual remote employee cannot attend the forum.
